notes.title: New DLC out: Virtual Thermae!
notes.content:
Duck friends,

After the latest FREE DLC that brought you the ducklings, today a new location arrived! 🌿

Welcome to [b]Virtual Thermae[/b], our brand-new ancient lakeside baths where serenity reigns and every duck floats a little lighter. In this DLC, you’ll escape to tranquil waters, breathe in fresh air, and bask in the peaceful vibes of nature.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3865410/Placid_Plastic_Duck__Virtual_Thermae/

Because sometimes you just need those timeless, gentle moments: warm stones, quiet waters, soft echoes. Whether you're just floating and watching the world drift by or hunting for clues, we hope that Virtual Thermae will bring a different kind of calm to your day.

So light the torches, whisper your duck-chant, and let the ancient waters heal your feathers.

The ducks deserve a spa-day too, and this is the time of a time long gone.

notes.title: The Ducks on iOS: play on your Apple device now!
notes.content:
Dear duck friends,

Those of you following our development journey know that bringing the ducks to mobile has been in the works for many months — and you also know about the challenges and hiccups we faced along the way…
But today, we’re happy to announce:

[b]Placid Plastic Duck Simulator is out now on iOS! [/b]🥳

You can head over to the App Store and download it on your iPhone right now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/bf3ffc260b8570394d048e06aaf7191ba1fb563c.png[/img]

And here’s more good news: [b]the first duck DLC, Ducks, Please, is included for free![/b] ːpartyduckː

“But what about Android?”

We’ve learned (the hard way) that iOS and Android follow different timelines and processes, so the delay is beyond our control (as usual, the ducks are figuring it out as they go).

But don’t worry — Android users are next, and you’ll be able to play the game next month. Thanks for your patience!

ːcoolduckː

PS: have you tried the free Steam demo of our upcoming duck deck game yet? you can play it now! 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3790860/Placid_Plastic_Deck__A_Quiet_Quest_Demo/

notes.title: A new FREE DLC is out: "Ducklings" + Happy Birthday PPDS!
notes.content:
Duck friends,

This year we decided to celebrate the ducks' birthday with a FREE DLC!

It’s our way of saying we’re having a whole lot of fun together: you, us, the ducks. ːpartyduckː

Let’s all get together to sing:
Happy 3rd birthday, Placid Plastic Duck Simulator!
And please give a warm welcome to the majestic [b]DUCKLINGS[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3809860/Placid_Plastic_Ducklings/

They’re new.
They’re few.
They’re cuuute!

15 new floaty units. Shorter, lighter, with highly compressed personalities.

Now you finally know why 3 mysterious achievements appeared. It was for a good cause!
See? Patience always gets rewarded. ːpartyduckː

We hope you’ll enjoy this little gift — and most of all, we hope you’ll have a blast partying with the ducklings.

They can’t wait to meet you!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/6e423f3772449ec20c2b2a3683d23f33b4c9c547.png[/img]

notes.title: VR Out Now, Mobile Coming Soon, Main Game Discounted!
notes.content:
Dear Duckies,

A lot to announce today!

Today is the day our first VR effort sees the light of day.

We always thought the ducks would feel at home in a virtual reality pool, and we finally managed to pull that off!

Yes, Early Access means you might still find it a bit rough around the edges, but we believe your relaxation shouldn't really be affected all that much. So go ahead, put your headset on, and find out what’s changed from the original game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3595010/Placid_Plastic_Duck_VR/

And now, a piece of news that should interest a broader duck crowd, since VR headset owners are still a minority among gamers (or an elite, if you prefer :coolduck:). So here’s the second big news:

As of today, Placid Plastic Duck Simulator officially has a mobile store page on iOS!

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/placid-plastic-duck-simulator/id6742243377


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/021019a5280ee5317a5876b6d08ca2f6f5129524.png[/img]


You can grab your smartphone and pre-order the game now, then see it appear among your apps the day it comes out next month. If you download it on day one, you’ll get a free DLC as a thank-you for your continued support!

If you're on Android, don't worry, PPDS will be available there very soon too.

And lastly, we’re pleased to announce that today, PPDS is on Steam’s front page!

To celebrate, a 50% discount is live — there’s no better time to grab the game if you haven’t yet (or gift it to that unaware friend and hear them say “what the duck” when they open it).

There's a 30% off on all DLCs, so the discount also affects the bundle!

Until the next announcement :smileduck:

notes.title: The duckiest bundle: Placid Duck Detective
notes.content:
Dear duckies,

It's nice to make friends, sure, but it's nicer when they are ducks because... DUCK POWER! ːcoolduckː

Let it be known that the ducks have teamed up for an overwhelmingly positive bundle of mystery-solving and chill vibes!

Put on your trench coat and quack your way through quirky cases, then swap it for a swimsuit and enjoy some well-deserved relaxation by the pool.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49672/Placid_Duck_Detective/

We are excited to be side by side with a fun game like Duck Detective: The Secret Salami. A big thank you to the HAPPY BROCCOLI team for being so friendly and cool!
 

On a different note, we have another piece of news we'd like to share today. Do any of you have friends who play with the ducks on console? If so, you can officially make yourself the bearer of great news:

the DLC known as [b]So Many Ducks[/b] is out on all consoles from today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/c19f549199940a112bd6b14a4c293509ce584b38.png[/img]

notes.title: "Ducks Galore" DLC and a Kickstarter on the horizon!
notes.content:
Duck friends,

There are many things to cover today!

[h3]New DLC[/h3]

Two DLCs in such a short time?
Yes! We’re thrilled we pulled this off, especially since we're busier than ever working on two more duck games. (If you’re reading this, you already know about them and have added them to your wishlist, right? :menacingduck:)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3295380/Placid_Plastic_Duck_Simulator__Ducks_Galore/


[h3]Secret Diorama Project[/h3]

Now, let’s talk about something exciting in the physical realm of analog ducks...

The amazing folks at Mojito Studios—a board game producer—approached us with a wild idea: a DUCK DIORAMA called [b]Placid Plastic Duck Studio[/b]. Could we say no? Of course not!

While nothing’s set in stone yet, they’ve already made a prototype (with water!), and they’re working on a Kickstarter campaign. If you’d like to help make this incredibly cool thing happen, head over to their presentation page to sign up as an interested backer: https://presale.mojitostudios.com/


The more people we can rally, the more likely it is this feverish vision will become a reality—so spread the word!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/6c35fa66a6f0ce3ba2fae0544aa40a8505ce9189.png[/img]

[h3]Game Update[/h3]

Finally, we made the PC and console versions more consistent. This is a [b]major update[/b], so expect some differences from the usual build and possibly some minor bugs. If you find something is not working as intended, please use the bug reports section in Steam Discussions.

[i]Known bug: Currently, the multiplayer saves are not working.[/i]

Good news is for the occasion, we managed to work on some quality-of-life improvements, such as:

[list]
[*] Controller Compatibility
[*] Revised UI
[*] Improved Performance - Graphics and CPU performance have been optimized
[*] Water Disappearance Bug Fix
[*] Other small things I forgot to take note of
[/list]

We'll keep working to fix and improve what we can.

Until next update!

notes.title: "Rooftop One Percent" DLC is now available!
notes.content:
My dear rooftop dwellers,

Big news! The "Rooftop 1%" DLC is officially live!

Ascend to new heights with this luxurious expansion, where only the finest vibes await. We're talking high-altitude relaxation with panoramic views and an exclusive array of ducks that know what it means to be part of the 1%.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3223500/Placid_Plastic_Duck__Rooftop_One_Percent/

This isn’t just another DLC—it’s your golden ticket to the penthouse of the duck world. Picture your ducks lounging by sleek rooftop pools, mingling with only the most elite plastic companions in town.

And because it’s been a while since our last DLC (not to mention a whole new location!), we’ve upped the ante with more than the usual 3 special ducks! That’s right—this rooftop brings even more flair and style to your serene plastic duck collection.

So join the ducks and let them bask in their rooftop paradise, living their best lives—until we discover the next peak to conquer.


[i]turbolento[/i]

notes.title: THE CARDS ARE DRAWN: Placid Plastic Deck, Announced
notes.content:
My dear duckies,

It's been a few months since we last published news here. This was not a forgetful silence—rest assured, you've been in our minds ever since we posted the first announcement in 2022. Rather, it was a "calm before the storm" kind of silence. We've been busy, very busy, and to be honest, we'll be busy for a little longer.

And yet, we've never been so happy to be this busy because we are working on a new, unexpected ducky-deck game!

If you consider that good news, hold on to your chair because today is the day you can watch the announcement trailer of [b]Placid Plastic Deck - A Quiet Quest[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2510020/Placid_Plastic_Deck__A_Quiet_Quest/

Go to our brand new Steam page and push that “[b]Add to Wishlist[/b]” button.

Did you ever dream of a world where ducks rule the card tables? Where you collect duck cards? Where ducks talk to you?

As the nice flock of duck aficionados we all are, we can make dreams come true.

Together!

--

Further general PPDS news:

[list]
[*] we are working on porting the game to mobile, which will happen before the year ends (with a little surprise)
[*] we are working on porting the remaining DLCs on all consoles, this should happen around November
[*] we want to produce a new DLC, we are aiming at December
[*] SSD is in progress and pretty much in line with our timeline
[/list]

notes.title: ANNOUNCING: Placid Plastic Desktop
notes.content:
Some things are done just for the sake of it. You don't need a reason, you just do it. Kind of for experimentation. For science!

If we had to give one reason for creating [b]Placid Plastic Desktop[/b], though, it's this trailer:


[previewyoutube=LZ2t5eOdv8o;full][/previewyoutube]

That said, we thought a small number of PPDS aficionados, as bonkers as we are, might enjoy being able to close the game and still have the ducks floating on their screen.

Or perhaps you just want yet another excuse to show love to the ducks and support them in their future endeavors (yes yes, we'll talk about the big things that are coming up next time, promise).

Either way, some things we just can't help but do.

This, is one of those things.

notes.title: Limited Time Bundle Promotion and Merry Christmas
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/34557/Idle_Game_Variety_Bundle/


[h2]Idle Games Variety Bundle[/h2]
A celebration of the variety among idle games, which are sadly often not seen as "real" games. Check out how different the world of idle games can be and play these games or just watch how they play themselves and stare at them.

[h2]Cookie Clicker[/h2]
Cookie Clicker is a game about making an absurd amount of cookies. To help you in this endeavor, you will recruit a wide variety of helpful cookie makers, like friendly Grandmas, Farms, Factories, and otherworldly Portals.

[h2]The Longing[/h2]
An unusual mix of adventure and idle game. In utter loneliness deep below the surface, it's your task to wait for the awakening of your king... for 400 days.

[h2]Placid Plastic Duck Simulator[/h2]
Just your favorite duck game.

-

And with that, let us wish you all a Merry Christmas! The holiday update is live and if you are new to the game you have some ducks to meet for a limited time!

notes.title: We’re taking part in the War Child UK Armistice Sale!
notes.content:
Dear duckies,

We’re taking part in the [b]War Child UK Armistice Sale[/b]!  

Between 8-15th November, we’ll donate [b]40% of every sale[/b] of PPDS to War Child UK. Make sure to grab your discounted copy, gift one to a friend or let them know about the sale. 

"This year’s Armistice Sale is celebrating peaceful play and highlighting the importance of protecting, educating, and standing up for the rights of children living in war zones. War Child work in the hardest to reach places to support those who are hardest hit, to protect, educate and stand up for the rights of children, when they need them most. 

By purchasing a game or DLC during the sale we can help to fund their projects in Ukraine, Afghanistan, Democratic Republic of Congo, Central African Republic, Iraq, and Yemen.

War Child will never give up on children affected by conflict."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/69602e0d2f589b22c56276794e61e3fbd0e39106.jpg[/img]

Find out more about War Child here - https://www.warchild.org.uk/our-work


--

On a different note, did you know you can now add new duck packs to existing save files? This means you don't have to start a new game next time a DLC comes out!

Just press the + button in your save list and add what you are missing, like so: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/209e1182e1dc3d6140fdad649400d97da2c625da.png[/img]

Just remember you can add a pack, not remove it.

Until the next update.

[i]turbolento games[/i]



PS: Our super hype t-shirt is back online at https://everpress.com/placid-being-placid just in time for the holiday season. If you missed it the first time, here's your second chance to snag one before Christmas comes around!

[i]turbolento games[/i]

notes.title: "So Many Ducks" DLC is now available!
notes.content:
My dear ducks,

Big news! "[b]So Many Duck[/b]" DLC is live! Dive into the pond with 27 new ducks, each bringing a new style if not actions and combos. Your relaxation level just hit the roof.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2579800/Placid_Plastic_Duck_Simulator__So_Many_Ducks/

We named it "So Many Ducks" because it's the 3rd additional duck pack—CAN YOU BELIEVE THAT?

Sometimes we wonder how many ducks are out there that we don't even know exist. Will we manage to meet them all eventually? I guess we can only wait and see!
But it feels good to imagine them floating peacefully somewhere, in a place where none of us is watching them.

Until there won't be so many, but too many instead.

[i]turbolento games[/i]

Dear duckies,

notes.title: Public lobbies, Emojis, and Graphic Settings
notes.content:
Dear duckies,

The birthday party event was a success, and we are delighted that so many of you joined us in celebrating one year of Placid Plastic Duck Simulator! ːpartyduckː

Now, it's time to clean up around the pool and return to normalcy.

As we do that, we also want to seize the opportunity to introduce something new—something we promised and something you didn't expect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/f163215502fbd4694f699e190b70901f60434c0b.png[/img]

1. From now on, as you play in a multiplayer game, you'll be able to spam emojis and let other players know how you feel about that unexpected bump you just received.

Just press the scroll wheel on your mouse and choose the emoji you want. Cool uh? ːcoolduckː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/3001600b4aed594710dc213617da351839080927.png[/img]

2. Public Lobbies are now a thing. Set it to "public" as you create a room as a host, or click on the magnifying glass when you want to join a room instead. ːsteamhappyː

3. Graphic Settings. Yes, they are here. Set it to low and see how nice the game can be when it's not mining cryptocurrencies. ːmenacingduckː

And that's all for now.

More news, big news, after the month of August. Be ready!


[i]turbolento games[/i]

notes.title: A Happy Birthday to the Ducks!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/e56fabc80bfaa1b8390daecc90e35eae07a32bd9.png[/img]

[i]WARNING: OVERLY SENTIMENTAL TEXT BELOW[/i]

My dear ducklings,

When we first released the game one year ago, we certainly didn't expect it to receive so much attention. We thought the vision we had was simply too weird to appeal to a vast audience.

We were wrong.

There are many of you, and you understand the spirit of the game very well. Sometimes, you understand it better than us even. You have supported and guided us throughout this whole first year. Every comment, review, screenshot, fan art, fan song, Twitch clip, Discord interaction, and tweet has contributed to the incredible story of this silly game that is not really a game.

PPDS is an indie project we casually dropped in the ocean of Steam as a floating message of love to anyone who would pick it up. And you did pick it up, sending it back to us like a big, sudden wave of love.

Let's recap what that wave has meant:

4 DLCs
2 additional locations
17 new achievements
1 Christmas event
9 special ducks
1 Discord server with 1464 ducks
7,868 reviews
3 console ports
1 open door

Today, we take a moment to celebrate our first year with the ducks!
We do that with 3 new event ducks, a present to show you all our gratitude. Naturally, they won't be available for long, and you must play the game to get them. You can't miss the party.

For you know, if you think about it, this is your birthday too!

[i]turbolento games[/i]



NB: graphic settings this month

notes.title: "Hippospace Download" DLC is here!
notes.content:
My dear ducks,

Jetpack your stuff, we are going to space!

Some time ago we received a postcard from cow duck inviting us to pay a visit. So we decided to go take a look, and thought why not bring you all with us? Join us on [b]Hippospace Download[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2400830/Placid_Plastic_Duck__Hippospace_Download/

3 new ducks and 4 new achievements await you - only if you are, as you should be by now, patient enough ːcoolduckː

Once again, thank you all for being part of the duck family. New content like this is only possible thanks to your invaluable support.

There's still so much relaxing and chilling to do, rest assured!

[i]turbolento games[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/9500e15fce736b31b324174eb77c8685d0a7fec0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: MULTIPLAYER is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/3228973c8d8f1a77c0614a8b85d940359e9c3565.jpg[/img]

My duck friends,

Among the many things we could add to the game (graphic settings, anyone?), we decided to bring you the silliest of them all: [b]the multiplayer![/b]

Have you ever dreamed of being able to select a particular duck and just be it as you float happily with your friends? Now you can! [i](do nothing with your friends)[/i]

A total of 8 people can now join the pool, choose from the collection any duck they have previously unlocked, and hang out together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/093c0196e7fff096c698ee28a8a11d99c4db30dc.png[/img]

Do you all want to pick helicopter duck? Do that and see who is the last one to remain in the pool, for a real Battle Royal experience. Or, get one fire-breathing duck among wood ducks, and the last one to catch on fire wins. The possibilities are endless!

Since testing is still ongoing, this is a BETA, which means:

- only the base location is available
- the door is not active
- errors might occur
- be patient ːmenacingduckː

And that's all for today. A shoutout to all the ducks in the Discord server who read this, you are the best!

More news soon. ːcoolduckː 
[i](yes, graphic settings are also in the works)[/i]

QUACK!

notes.title: The ducks make friends: 3 gifted ducks and a "World of Placid Plastic Duckships"
notes.content:
Dear ducklings,

Thanks to you all, the ducks are really going places we didn't expect.

d- First:

As a sign of appreciation towards our unbelievably friendly community of hardcore gamers, we are adding [b]special ducks[/b] to the Infinity Cool location today.

These are 3 gaming-related ducks. Do you want to know more? You'll have to get into the game and wait. For now, I will only say that one of them is a crossover. Our first duck crossover!

Thanks to you the word about PPDS is spreading far and wide, so much so that [b]a new flock of ducks[/b] decided to join in and they are now ready to meet you in your favorite pool!

So kick back, relax, and watch them as they do what they do best: floating. But expect some hiding, dancing, scanning, and other things.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2303400/Placid_Plastic_Duck_Simulator__Duck_Addiction/

What else? Ah right, save slots. We promised we would add one [b]additional save slot[/b], one for each location. We added 6 instead! ːcoolduckː  [i](does that mean we'll eventually get to 6 locations? no. I don't know. maybe. ːnerdduckː)[/i]

We also added a little something we call a [b]cinematic camera[/b], which comes in handy when you leave the game open without interacting: the camera will automatically switch from duck to duck (or spot) after the game is left idle for a while. You can turn this function off from the settings.

Lastly, if you check the controls section, you'll notice how now you can [b]stop the duck spawn[/b] by pressing Y.

To recap:
- 3 additional achievements
- 6 save slots
- cinematic camera
- Y to stop spawning ducks

And this is all for now.

As always, thank you for your support. The duck family keeps expanding, and as long as the word keeps spreading, more content will never cease to come!

My duckies,

The first Placid Plastic Duck Simulator [b]expansion [/b] is on its way and will soon be with you all.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2142510/Placid_Plastic_Duck_Simulator__Ducks_Please/?beta=0]Wishlist it now![/url]

It's now almost 10 days since release day; it's amazing to watch so many people playing and streaming and to read so many comments, reviews, and feedback.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/4b559343e0fe92e8d9ff80eeadc883f4a80d567e.png[/img]

[list]

[*] Occlusion culling making the camera go through objects
[*] Ducks ending too often stranded out of the pool
[*] Golf ball achievement triggering randomly
[*] Fps and GPU usage
[*] Korean and Japanese languages
[/list]

notes.title: The ducks have landed. Placid Plastic Duck Simulator is out now!
notes.content:
[b]Hello my duckies![/b]

A project that was born as an experiment aiming at pushing the boundaries of what can be defined as a game - a tongue-in-cheek experiment - now feels like a project with a lot of potential to me.

For now, though, I'm just happy it made it to the real world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/e1298cd6950ae335a8b9c40a93932c48f3318f1a.png[/img]

I hope you'll get some relaxation and good vibes out of this little game. I want to keep working on it, but I'll make up my mind once (or rather, if) people confirm my vision is not just the result of a personal delirium. Can you see rubber ducks float everywhere? I can see them inside a solitary bathtub on top of a mountain, in a Japanese zen pond, in a skyscraper's infinity pool over New York, in a water park, in a golf course, in Roman thermal baths... Everywhere I say!

But let's not get fixed on the future, rather let's enjoy the present moment and focus on what we have right here and right now. Just like our rubber ducks teach us, we can be happy with what we have.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/18842d9479c736e01de7d49f4278751a47effcc5.jpg[/img]

[b]Placid Plastic Duck Simulator[/b] is maybe not much, but I am happy with it.

I hope you can be happy too.

[i]turbolento games[/i]

notes.title: It's summertime! The buoyant rubber ducks are almost here
notes.content:
Hello my duckies!

I just wanted to say hi to all the people who started following this weird project of mine.

I say weird because I guess it's not common to make a game where you basically are - though active - a simple spectator.

But I'm sure what is definitely not weird is the aim of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/d2b5c56b93f57e40df0856340af2a8fae91cd7e0.png[/img]

I often find peace in the simplest of things, and many times in the past I found myself enjoying a little part of an MMORPG, an adventure game, or even a shooter, that was there just as a break from the real in-game activities. With enough love and vision, I thought, those breaks could work as a game on their own.

I recently got inspired by new titles that I consider the new wave of relaxing games, and it seems to me that many players are nowadays looking for those nice little breaks between the hustle of more energy-demanding games. I'm thinking of Unpacking, Dorfromantik, or Potion Craft, to name a few.

That's where I come from with [b]Placid Plastic Duck Simulator[/b]. I want it to be nice to look at and relaxing. It should generate brief moments of awe in the player thanks to the simplest of things. The same awe of a child pointing at an airplane in the sky.

And yet, I have so many ideas of the things that could be done in such an environment. I hope to be able to work on them once the game is out. I'm counting on your feedback to give the right priority to all of them.

I want to thank the people who wishlisted the game and read this introduction. A special thank you goes to the good people who voluntarily translated the Steam page and the game for now: dashimaru, Elisabet Obradors, Jussetin Tamarre, ゴムあひる, and CAngus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42442493/a95e9e3d1ff3020f1c8660993b6245651bf20d30.png[/img]

And that's all for this first post. Let's see how things will evolve eventually.

I'm sure, eventually, everything is going to be all right.

:)
